name: scrum-poker
description: Внутренний инструмент командной оценки задач (Planning Poker)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @scrum-poker/server && npm run build -w @scrum-poker/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
